response.original_title: (@Expert-Officiall=-Guide)How do i add another room to my Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, 1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) you can add another room to your Royal Caribbean Cruise if cabins are still available on your sailing, though you generally need to book it as a separate reservation and ask Royal Caribbean or your travel advisor to link the bookings. To add an extra room or stateroom to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises 1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada), you cannot do it online or through the mobile app. Call 1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) customer service or your travel agent: Reach out to Royal Caribbean Cruises customer service directly at 1-866-829-1280, or contact the travel advisor who handled your original reservation. To add another stateroom to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises reservation, you must book a separate cabin through Royal Caribbean Cruises 1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or your travel advisor and have the two bookings linked, as adding a second room cannot be done directly in an existing online reservation.
